correctness.rationale: Reconstructed four exhaustive positive-integer regimes. For d,q>=2, the explicit S_d⊕J_{(q−1)d+1} has PQ exactly {dq,d(q+1),...}. Conversely at first permissible m=dq, the cited finite-dimensional block lemma and A*X=0 with invertible A split T=A⊕B, B^m=0. Large exponents force PQ(A)=dN; missing exponent (q−1)d forces B^{(q−1)d} nonzero, so dim B >= (q−1)d+1; d>1 forces dim A>=2. d=1 and q=1 boundary arguments separately match. Source-side abstract/log alone not used.
